Method in one paragraph

Demand: level x weekday profile x holiday factor, estimated on six weeks of history with Presidents' Day mapped to the MLK window, Valentine's as a stated assumption; weekly level noise 3.3%. Service: wait = b / (1 - u/c) per department with a warehouse factor, fitted by leave-one-week-out CV; P(meet) drops below 90% between u = 0.84 and 0.88. Callouts: binomial at historical rates, half backfilled while overtime room remains. Optimizer: per warehouse x date x shift, the cheapest (FE, Merch) pair with both departments at the target under the official fill rule (regular, then cross-trained, then OT); where the target is out of reach, expected misses are minimised and the block is flagged.
